7422.title: Browser execution omits its host deadline override
7422.rootCauseOneLine: The browser run handler forwards the script timeout only as method input, leaving the separate host deadline at its 30-second default.

prReviews.verdict: Root-cause fix supported by static review only
prReviews.topFinding: The open linked PR supplies a bounded host-call allowance at the verified shared run boundary; its branch was not executed.

7422.proposedFix: Pass the validated script budget plus a bounded response allowance in the existing host-call timeout option.
7422.caveats: Two clean-checkout RPC-boundary reproductions; no live browser timing was measured. Existing linked open PR #7423 prevents a duplicate fix PR. Test source and output are inline in the report.
